title: Near-end callback for hosts that page issues by column
description: Papyrus loads more records by watching scroll events on .kb-column-scroll elements directly (components/newsroom-board-view.tsx, loadMoreWhenColumnIsNearItsEnd). A stacked board has no per-column scroller, so that paging would silently stop. Add onColumnNearEnd?: (columnKey: string) => void and a threshold to Board and IssueCollection, fired in both layouts when the end of a column's cards comes within the threshold of the viewport, including when a short column is already fully visible on first render. Do not fire for collapsed columns. Acceptance: scenarios for both layouts, and no repeated firing while the issue list is unchanged. Document it in packages/ui/README.md as the supported way to page, instead of reading internal class names.
